item.title: Utah crews remove 17 million tons of radioactive waste from Colorado River site
item.description: The Moab Uranium Mill Tailings Remedial Action Project has efficiently relocated 17 million tons of waste from the riverbank. Following rail transportation, teams are actively monitoring groundwater contamination levels. Upcoming efforts will also involve excavating contaminated soil near the original tailings site. The objective is to guarantee long-term safety and stability for local residents and the ecosystem. Ultimately, regrading and revegetating the area will be crucial in preventing future erosion. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Tennessee suspende aplicación de pena de muerte hasta 2027 por fallida ejecución de Christa Pike
item.description: Christa Pike, la primera mujer que recibe la pena de muerte en Tennessee en 200 años, sobrevivió a las dos primeras dosis de la inyección letal que le fueron administradas durante su ejecución la noche del 30 de septiembre, informó Luke Ihnen, defensor público federal adjunto de su equipo de defensa. item.title: Fake BBC report falsely implicates Indian passenger and pilot in Flydubai hijacking attempt
item.description: False videos are circulating after the attempted hijacking of a Flydubai flight between Dubai and Tel Aviv. One fake “BBC” report falsely claims an Indian passenger was behind the incident and links him to the stabbed pilot, Smit Machchhar. The video though, is an AI-generated deepfake: the BBC never broadcast it, and its footage and audio were doctored. A second clip was also misrepresented and filmed in Dubai, not over where the incident occurred. Vedika Bahl fact-checks in Truth or Fake. Fuente: France 24 - English.
